Task: 001 — Establish Postgres, source selection and Users/Roles reads
Linked: dev/milestones/v0.4-data-layer/001-data-foundation.md

Stack: first layer, base `main`; merge/cherry-pick order 001 → 002 → 003 → 004 → 005 → 006 → 007 → 008. Layer compare: https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/compare/main...feat/v0.4/001-data-foundation

### Acceptance criteria
- [x] Add Docker Compose with Postgres 17, a health check, named local volume and documented local credentials/port. Docker is optional for demo use and never contacted by install, dev or build when DATABASE_URL is unset.
- [x] Add Drizzle config, a lazy server-only postgres.js client, normalized user/role tables and actual existing relationships (including ordered workspace membership where present). Preserve distinct fixture identities and role display semantics; no authentication or enforcement.
- [x] Create the shared typed metric-points schema contract for subsequent tasks: domain/series identifier, ordered point key, typed value/unit and dimensions as needed, uniqueness and deterministic ordering. No whole-fixture JSON payloads; entity lists use entity tables. Later tasks add only their necessary columns/relations.
- [x] Implement one source selector: absent DATABASE_URL selects demo; configured DATABASE_URL selects db; DATA_SOURCE=demo overrides even a broken URL. Validate unsupported DATA_SOURCE values explicitly; do not reinterpret malformed/empty configured credentials as permission to fall back. Never expose URLs/credentials to the browser or logs.
- [x] Provide db:generate, db:migrate, db:seed and data:parity scripts. Commit generated SQL and Drizzle migration metadata under src/server/db/migrations/. Database commands require an explicit local target and fail clearly when unavailable; never run migrations/seeding on application startup.
- [x] Use a transactional, repeatable seed with stable fixture identifiers and explicit row ordering. Re-seeding the owned demo rows must not duplicate records; avoid blanket truncation or deletion of unrelated data. Document a manual Docker start command; no reset/up npm helper is needed unless justified in this task PR.
- [x] Add typed users.ts and roles.ts reads under src/server/data/ with explicit demo/db implementations. Route loaders invoke TanStack Start GET server functions, then feed props to components; no component/runtime fixture import remains for these domains. Database queries and the driver stay outside the browser bundle.
- [x] Define a read-function registry and parity harness. Compare every registered function with identical validated inputs/context through both real implementations against seeded Docker Postgres; preserve array ordering, IDs, nullability, dates, money and counts. Fail nonzero on differences, omitted registrations or DB failures; never normalize away substantive differences. Prove the harness fails with a controlled mismatch and cannot pass by calling demo twice.
- [x] A refused connection, invalid credentials and missing schema surface a safe, visible load error through the existing error boundary; no silent demo data, raw SQL or secret-bearing error text. Verify recovery after fixing the connection and retrying.
- [x] Workers build/upload and demo route smoke pass without DATABASE_URL, without Docker and without attempted DB connections. No Hyperdrive, Neon account, production database or new secret binding.

- [x] All [milestone test-floor gates](README.md#test-floor-and-evidence) pass for this task: build/check/typecheck; zero-env demo and actual Docker Postgres reads; parity for owned reads; dev `/dashboard/default` plus owned-route smoke; Workers demo version preview.
- [x] Capture and inspect incumbent → demo after → seeded DB for owned routes in light/dark × desktop (1440×900)/mobile (390×844), including listed variants. Attach four-state comparisons; no visual change is expected. Keep evidence on `pr-assets` or PR attachments, never main.
- [x] README reflects verified commands/behavior/status and the PR states `README: updated (sections …)` or `README: no change needed (reason)`. Update task acceptance and `dev/milestones.json` only from evidence; leave in review until merged.

### Files touched
- `src/server/db`, `drizzle.config.ts`, Compose and env example: local database, schema, seed and migration journal.
- `src/server/data`, database/parity/source QA scripts: source selection, actual implementations and verification.
- Users/Roles fixtures and route loaders: split serializable records from UI metadata, preserve prop boundaries, derive the existing review count from loaded rows.
- package/lockfile: only approved Drizzle/postgres dependencies and commands.
- README/task status: optional onboarding and truthful review status.

### Tests
Build/check/typecheck pass. Demo and DB each pass 12 four-state route/interaction cases. Postgres 17.10: migrate twice, seed twice; 25 users, 12 roles, 31 memberships, 52 permissions; parity 2 reads/6 scenarios passing. Source matrix passes 10 scenarios plus both negative controls; browser faults/forced demo/recovery pass 20 four-state cases. Real database row mutation fails parity and reseeding restores it. Latest Workers direct/refresh smoke passes 24/24; interaction Workers version also passes 24/24. No-Docker demo passes 12/12. An initial DB default light/mobile harness call failed with `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'textContent')`; all four default cases passed on explicit retry, retained with the original report.

Inherited warnings: Base UI module-directive/build notices, mixed transition/animation warning, lint diagnostics, ts-node fs.Stats deprecation, Wrangler missing optional OAuth scopes. New tooling warning: drizzle-kit transitively introduces four moderate npm audit findings; no additional runtime dependency added.

### Screenshots
[All screenshots/logs/parity evidence](https://github.com/moeghashim/tenboards/tree/pr-assets/v04-001). 92/104 before-to-final demo/DB PNG comparisons are byte-equivalent at decoded pixels; remaining tiny differences are animated activity dots/focus edge rendering. No data masks. The intermediate Roles count text-node regression was found visually, fixed and recaptured.

### Decisions
PLAN v0.4 source/access/modelling/driver decisions apply. Prefactor: preserve existing table props and separate server fixtures from UI metadata/types. Directory role labels intentionally remain distinct from role-catalog records. Postgres 17 Alpine uses the available local image. No auth, runtime reset helper, new unapproved dependency, protected wrappers, production deployment or merge.

Seed typed draft/date-offset definitions rather than a permanently stale seed-time date; both sources resolve the same request context without separate clocks. Include month/year/leap-day boundaries in parity.
- [x] Preserve product local edit/duplicate behavior and validation-only Add, invoice local calculations/reorder/editor/preview/print, order filters/pagination and every current chart/range control. No database write endpoint, persistence, upload, payment, Save or Send behavior is added.

### Acceptance criteria
- [x] Normalize Productivity projects/tasks/notes/goals/focus/quote data; Academy classes/rooms/schedule/events/performance; Logistics customer/contact/shipment/package/tracking/location rows; Infrastructure projects/groups/environments/resources; Patient identities/beds/clinical metadata/baseline vitals/alarm records. Move every business literal/KPI/summary into entity fields or typed metric points, including Infrastructure header totals and Academy schedule JSX.

Only simulated waveforms/trends/live clocks are exempt; all persistent patient records and baseline inputs go through patients.ts. Audit and document the exact exception without allowing ordinary chart data to bypass the layer.

An initial source-browser invocation lacked DATABASE_URL and failed before tests; the configured 20-case run passes. ### Decisions
Prefactor inspection extracted Academy schedule rows and operational inline values into plain records, separated icon presentation, and injected loaded shipment/monitor data at existing component boundaries. Entity relationships remain domain-specific. Numeric metrics and precise coordinates are loaded; no whole-record JSON payloads or new dependencies.

The explicit client-signal exception is confined to waveform-data.ts, realtime-utils.ts, use-patient-vital-series.ts and use-realtime-tick.ts plus their presentation geometry/calibration/axis labels. Persistent patient records, baseline parameters, alarm content and monitor settings use the data layer. Real clocks, SSR snapshots and reduced motion are preserved. No auth/CRUD/feed, protected UI edits, merge or production deployment. No open questions for this layer; task 008 performs the whole-tree acceptance audit.
